text: Airwallex is a private, venture-capital-backed fintech, not a publicly traded company. Its own 2018 Series B announcement names its investors as Tencent, Sequoia Capital China, Hillhouse, Sir Ka-shing Li's Horizons Ventures, Central Capital Ventura and Square Peg Capital; no state or state-fund investor is named.

source.name: Airwallex Newsroom: Airwallex closes Series B fundraising with US$80m
source.quote: Tencent and Sequoia China were joined by fellow China based Hillhouse, Sir Ka-Shing Li's Horizons Ventures from Hong Kong, Indonesia's Central Capital Ventura
